250_words.text:
Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio that turns photos into digital keepsakes. It is designed for pet owners who want to create portraits of their cats or dogs using their own reference images. Start with one to five clear photos of the same pet, choose a style, and generate a portrait. Available looks include watercolor, royal costumes, studio portraits and window seat scenes.

Clear photos with visible eyes and natural fur markings help guide the result. The studio accepts JPG, PNG and WebP files up to 8 MB each. Once a portrait is ready, users can view and download it from the studio or return to My creations to revisit their results.

Two beta tools extend the workflow. You & your pet combines a separate person photo with pet reference photos to create a portrait together. Photo cleanup lets users describe changes to an existing pet photo, such as removing a cable or background clutter. These are generative tools, so faces, coat markings and fine details may change. Users should review the result carefully.

Pettenderly uses paid credits. A Starter Pack costs $4.99 and includes 12 credits without an expiration date. Pro subscriptions provide 40 credits per month; unused monthly credits do not roll over. Each successful image uses one credit, while failed generations do not use credits. The finished product is a downloadable digital image. The service does not include physical printing or shipping, and there is no promise of exact likeness or a fixed generation speed.
